_source: Book facts for gregmaxfield.com. Workbook facts are synced from the vault's 05_Projects/Operation_Granny_Files/OGF_Content_Registry.md (Books & Products + IngramSpark tables) by the CoS site-upkeep task; edit the registry, not this file. After editing, run `npm run gen:buy` to regenerate the /buy redirects in vercel.json.
_bookshop_note: TLC formats with an isbn (IngramSpark ISBN, not the KDP one) also get /buy/tlc-<format>-bookshop/<placement> -> bookshop.org/book/<isbn>. Verified live on Bookshop.org 2026-10-09 (PB $16.99, HC $26.99).

attribution._note: Amazon Attribution tag query strings, one per placement (e.g. "maas=maas_adg_XXXX&ref_=aa_maas"). PLACEHOLDER values are skipped — the redirect then goes to the clean Amazon URL. The Chairman creates the real tags once in Amazon Attribution; paste each here and run `npm run gen:buy`.

workbooks.title: Family History Adventures
workbooks.summary: The first steps of family history for homeschool families: what family history is, interviewing a relative, hunting for family documents, drawing a four-generation family tree, keeping a research notebook, and reading the census.
workbooks.audience: Homeschool families with learners ages 8–14 (roughly Grades 3–8).

workbooks.title: DNA & Family Tree Building
workbooks.summary: Genetic genealogy made hands-on: what DNA is, taking a test, reading results, meeting DNA cousins, building a DNA-informed family tree, and a capstone family mystery to solve.
units: DNA Detective: Solving a Family Mystery

workbooks.title: Telling the Story
workbooks.summary: Turning family research into writing — from the records and interviews gathered in Workbooks 1 and 2 to a family story worth sharing. The capstone of the series.
workbooks.audience: Homeschool families; completes the three-volume series.
